title: The Spectral Distribution of Matrix Least Squares Solutions, and the Ellipsoid Fitting Problem
abstract: arXiv:2611.23431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the spectral distribution of the least squares solution to a random linear system whose unknown is a symmetric matrix. In the normalized and isotropic setting, we derive a closed-form description of the support of the spectral distribution. As an application, we consider the ellipsoid fitting problem: given $n$ standard Gaussian vectors in $\mathbb{R}^d$, does there exist a centered ellipsoid passing through all of them? It was recently shown that this problem has a sharp phase transition at $n \approx d^2/4$. On the satisfiability side, unlike earlier results, these sharp results do not rely on least squares candidates. translated_title: 矩阵最小二乘解的谱分布与椭球拟合问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究未知量为对称矩阵的随机线性系统的最小二乘解的谱分布。在归一化和各向同性的设定下，我们推导出了谱分布支撑集的闭式描述。作为应用，我们考虑椭球拟合问题：给定 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中的 $n$ 个标准高斯向量，是否存在一个中心椭球经过所有这些点？最近有研究表明，该问题在 $n \approx d^2/4$ 处存在尖锐的相变。在可满足性方面，与早期结果不同，这些尖锐的结果并不依赖于最小二乘候选解。我们证明了早期工作中所考虑的最小二乘候选解在 $n \approx d^2/10$ 处存在半正定性阈值，这一现象此前已通过数值方法观察到，并由统计物理方法非严格地预测。此外，我们还证明了相应的最小二乘对偶证书……
tldr: 本文研究了未知量为对称矩阵的随机线性系统最小二乘解的谱分布并给出其支撑集的闭式描述，进而应用于椭球拟合问题，证明了最小二乘候选解在 n ≈ d²/10 处存在半正定性阈值。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a closed-form description of the spectral distribution's support for least squares solutions of random linear systems with symmetric matrix unknowns, and applies it to the ellipsoid fitting problem, proving a positive semi-definiteness threshold at n ≈ d²/10 for least squares candidates.
